pythonFunction.name: request_credit_refund
pythonFunction.description:
Submits a refund request for the credit balance on the account. The refund is paid through the
billing system in 10 to 15 business days. Needs an authenticated caller who agreed to the refund
of the credit amount. Refuses when the account has no credit. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the authenticated account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, reference_number, amount and processing_time.
